rule: An old scheme name resolves to the renamed fund. key is normalize(oldName).join(' '). An alias applies only where its target is one of the candidates being matched, after the stable identifiers and the exact vendor key and before the exact normalised name. It covers the Regular and Direct plans: a holding whose own name says Direct takes the direct target, any other the regular target. requiresPhrase, when present, must appear in the holding's own name (lower case, spaces collapsed), or the alias does not apply. Every line needs the owner's approval (OD-5, PD-36), with public evidence. Line 10 of the evidence list (Aditya Birla SL Equity Advantage Fund) is on hold and deliberately absent.
